meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: Claude 会生成一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片:一个可导航的演示 deck,含独立幻灯片、片段逐条显现、分支跳转、热点导航和演讲者备注,并内置演示模式;也能把现有网页转成 deck。输出是可导航的 deck,不是 MP4。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求幻灯片/演示文稿时触发;若只是提到“presentation”“pitch deck”等词,或要求转换页面,会先询问是否要做成 HyperFrames slideshow,确认后才执行。

say.text: 做一个 HyperFrames 幻灯片,讲产品发布。
say.note: 产出可导航的 deck,带独立幻灯片。

say.text: 把这个网页转成幻灯片 deck。
say.note: 会按原页面视觉和交互迁移成 deck。

say.text: 生成带分支和演讲者备注的 pitch deck。
say.note: 得到有热点跳转和备注的交互式 deck。

howto.what_en: Claude will produce a HyperFrames slideshow: a navigable deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and presenter mode with speaker notes; it can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks for a slideshow or deck. If the request is adjacent (e.g. 'presentation', 'pitch deck', 'convert this page'), Claude pauses and asks whether to build it as a HyperFrames slideshow before proceeding.

say_en.text: Create a HyperFrames slideshow about the product launch.
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck with separate slides.

say_en.text: Turn this webpage into a slideshow deck.
say_en.note: Migrates the page's visuals and interactions into a deck.

say_en.text: Make a pitch deck with branching and speaker notes.
say_en.note: Yields an interactive deck with hotspots and notes.
